text:
maria: Quick sync 1: we need to lock speakers, a tight run-of-show, and fallback plan for the "Benchmarks, Routing & Cost" webinar. who can confirm available slots and demo ownership?
aj: I can lead the live demo. keep it compact  6-7 minutes, show 3 model profiles side-by-side (latency, token cost, output).
sam: I'll produce a recorded deep-dive as fallback. last webcast had stream jitter; fallback is a must. :grimacing:
elaine: Ill handle the product/architecture segment and the decision matrix slide (4 min). will draft an abstract line now.
maria: Great. aj can you list the exact model configs you'll demonstrate? need to align copy.
aj: Demo plan: rdm-7b-q8 (fast/cheap), rdm-13b-fp16 (balanced), rdm-34b-ptx (high-quality). run same prompt set; capture p95 latency, avg tokens, and a short output snippet.
sam: I'll upload the fallback recording to the shared folder. link required in the calendar invite.
maria: Abstract choices for landing page (pick one): 1) "Benchmark-driven rules to trim inference cost without degrading UX." 2) "Practical routing & caching tactics for predictable latency at scale." 3) "How to choose model variants for cost-sensitive production apps." pick a winner.
elaine: Option 2 is my vote. hooks into the routing narrative.
aj: 2 works. short abstract we can use: "See how routing, quantization, and caching combine to deliver predictable latencies and lower token spend in production."
maria: Speaker bios (2 lines each) please:
sam: "Sam K 7 Solutions Engineer 7 works with customers on demo ops and inference cost optimization."
elaine: "Elaine W 7 Product Lead, Routing & Orchestration 7 focuses on reliability and SLO-driven routing."
aj: "AJ P 7 Runtime Eng 7 builds batching, kernel tuning, and low-latency paths in prod."
maria: Rehearsal options: Mon 11am PT, Wed 2pm PT (preferred), Thu 5pm PT. which is best?
aj: Wed 2pm PT works for me.
sam: Wed works. I need the recorded fallback uploaded by Tue EOD.
elaine: Wed fine.
maria: Scheduling Wed 2pm PT. rehearsal-bot: please set a reminder.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder set: "Benchmarks webinar rehearsal" Wed 2:00 PM PT. Invitees: maria, aj, sam, elaine.
ops-bot: Please upload fallback to /shared/marketing/webinars/benchmarks/fallback.mp4 before Tue 11:59 PM PT.
sam: Uploaded fallback at 2770014000  link: https://drive.redwood.co/webinars/benchmarks/fallback.mp4
aj: Draft run-of-show (quick pass) 
```
0:00-0:30  Host intro + housekeeping (maria)
0:30-4:30  Product + arch + why routing matters (elaine)
4:30-11:30 Live demo (aj) 3 configs: p95 latency, token cost, output diff
11:30-13:00 Fallback demo play (sam) if live has issues
13:00-23:00 Panel Q&A (all)
23:00-25:00 CTA/next steps and follow-up assets (maria)
```
maria: Nice. a couple edits: trim product intro to 3.5 min, and put a callout slide at 2:30 with a copy-paste routing YAML for ops.
aj: I'll include a compact routing snippet for copy-paste. sample:
```
routes:
  - purpose: low-latency
    model: rdm-7b-q8
  - purpose: quality-fallback
    model: rdm-34b-ptx
    region: us-west-2
```
elaine: Also plan to show the telemetry dashboard for per-route latency and token breakdowns. that's persuasive for platform teams.
sam: I'll prepare a dashboard clip showing cost delta and per-token breakdown for each model.
maria: Marketing needs: 3-line landing abstract (we have), 30-word social blurb, one tweetable stat. any suggestions?
aj: Tweet stat: "Routing + quantization reduced median latency by 2.8x and cut per-call token spend by ~30% in our workload tests."
sam: Social blurb: "Live demo: see how routing, caching, and model choices combine to give predictable latency and lower inference costs. Live demos + Q&A."
maria: Perfect. design needs hero image: high-contrast bar chart from demo. aj, sam: can you export a 16:9 PNG with labeled axes?
aj: Will export PNG after rehearsal tests.
sam: Will prepare chart and share in drive.
maria: One more slide request: 1-slide decision matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with recommended triggers. aj, can you draft?
aj: Yup. will post by Tue 6pm PT.
elaine: During rehearsals let's use truncated prompt set to avoid flakiness and reduce runtime. full prompt set for live on production infra.
maria: Good. who monitors the registration chat during live for incoming questions?
elaine: I can triage and surface technical ones to Sam.
sam: I'll handle deep technical threads.
maria: Thanks all. i'll update the calendar invite and landing page copy, then close this thread when done. :tada: 
aj: excited rocket
rehearsal-bot: Rehearsal recording scheduled to start Wed 2:00 PM PT.
